layout_and_sections.description: Glassmorphism header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200/80), containing brand logo image, navigation links (About, Services, How It Works, Advantages, FAQ, Contact), DE/EN language switcher button, and primary CTA button 'Angebot anfordern / Request Quote'. Includes z-50 fixed hierarchy.

Awwwards-level kinetic hero featuring line-by-line staggered reveal text, badge 'ISO 9001 & ISO 14001 Certified', 20+ years expertise callout, interactive glass wipe / squeegee sweep card effect (hover to simulate glass cleaning), dual CTAs ('Kostenloses Angebot' and 'Leistungen entdecken'), and trusted clients logo ticker.

Slow, low-contrast continuous text ribbon displaying key industry values and certifications: 'GEBÄUDEREINIGUNG • GLAS- & FENSTERREINIGUNG • UNTERHALTSREINIGUNG • ECO CERTIFIED • 24/7 FLEIBILITÄT • DEUTSCHE QUALITÄT'.

Numbered manifesto chapters (01 Precision & Standards, 02 Eco-Hygiene Innovation, 03 Tailored Facility Care), treated spotlight photography with clipped frames, live counter stats (20+ Years Experience, 1,200+ Properties Cleaned, 99.8% Satisfaction, 100% Eco Solutions).

Asymmetric bento grid showcasing 6 core cleaning services: 1. Büroreinigung (Office Cleaning), 2. Glas- & Fensterreinigung (Window Cleaning), 3. Treppenhausreinigung (Stairwell Cleaning), 4. Industriereinigung (Industrial Cleaning), 5. Baugrob- & Feinreinigung (Construction Cleanup), 6. Unterhaltsreinigung (Maintenance Cleaning). Features tab filter, modal detail view, and custom icons.

Numbered 4-step progressive timeline: 01. Kostenlose Erstbesichtigung (Free On-site Inspection), 02. Maßgeschneiderter Reinigungsplan (Custom Service Plan), 03. Professionelle Ausführung (Certified Execution), 04. Q-Audit & Betreuung (Continuous Quality Control).
Bento showcase highlights: 24/7 Shift Flexibility, Eco-Friendly Non-Toxic Cleaning Agents, Fully Insured & Vetted Staff, Modern Machinery, Transparent Flat-Rate Pricing.
Interactive FAQ accordion with category filter (General, Pricing, Security, Eco) answering key client questions in DE and EN.

High-converting corporate contact form section. Fields: Full Name, Phone Number, Email Address, Facility Location/City, Selected Service Dropdown, Message. Includes a dedicated 'Fill Demo Data' button for easy testing, instant submission handler that posts to database API, and Sonner toast success message.

Rich corporate footer with deep navy background, huge brand signature, address placeholders (Musterstraße 123, 10115 Berlin, Deutschland), phone (+49 (0) 30 12345678), email (info@la-gebaeudereinigung.de), working hours, legal links (Impressum, Datenschutz, AGB), and language switcher.

Separate route at /admin displaying all contact form submissions stored in backend database. Features table with status badges (New, Contacted, In Progress, Archived), search by name/email/city, filter by service, delete action, export CSV button, and quick statistics counter.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind and Google fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans, Playfair Display) in index.html and index.css.
2. Implement Lenis smooth scrolling for smooth momentum scrolling across the landing page.
3. Build the DE/EN internationalization state context so all text toggles instantly when user clicks DE/EN.
4. Use framer-motion for masked line-by-line reveal in hero title and scroll-triggered fade/slide animations for sections.
5. Ensure Header has backdrop-blur glassmorphism background (#FFFFFF with opacity and backdrop-filter), z-50 fixed layer, and data-testid attributes.
6. Build the Interactive Glass Wipe card in Hero: hover or drag effect that moves a squeegee line uncovering pristine glass underlying photography.
7. Implement the Contact Form with local state and full backend DB integration (/api/contact or SQLite/FastAPI backend endpoint) so submissions persist and are displayed in /admin.
8. Implement the 'Fill Demo Data' button in Contact section which auto-populates inputs with valid test data.
9. Build the /admin page with a clean table view, search filter, status badges, and delete functionality.
10. Ensure EVERY interactive element has data-testid attribute adhering to the testid table guidelines.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered SaaS layouts. Use asymmetric bento grids and crisp 1px borders (#E2E8F0) tinted with navy.
Never use dark gradients; keep background clean light slate (#F8FAFC) or crisp white with navy text for high APCA contrast.
Header must NEVER be fully transparent. Always apply backdrop-blur-xl with light white tint.
All buttons must have subtle spring animations on hover and active click states.
Use sonner for toast notifications when user submits form or fills demo data.
Add data-testid to every button, link, input, select, and key text element.
